naive.notes: This project's own implementation, tested in tests/test_baselines.py. Intervals from empirical residual quantiles at the matching seasonal lag.

foundation.notes: amazon/chronos-bolt-small, zero-shot, no training on this data; context 512d; quantiles emitted directly by the model.

classical.notes: AutoETS and AutoARIMA select their own orders per series; intervals are the library's parametric ones.

gbm.notes: One global model across all series; lags 1/7/14/21/28 plus calendar features; conformal prediction intervals.

neural.notes: Global models, input window 112d, multi-quantile loss, fixed budget of 400 steps on CPU, no early stopping.
